metadata.name: dsh-restart-backend

paragraphs.text: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 页面左下角添加“重启后端”按钮，一键重启 dsh 后端进程。
Adds a **Restart Backend** button to the bottom-left of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web sidebar. Clic
k it to restart the `dsh web` backend process in one step.
When the button is clicked, the Host side spawns a detached watchdog that waits for the current `dsh
web` process to exit and release its port, then starts a fresh `dsh web` process with the same star
tup arguments. The old process exits gracefully through `ctx.appExit`.
